sentences.text: One sunny day, five friends walk in the woods.
They are Mia, Tom, Jake, Lily, and Sam.
The light is bright and blue.
The spaceship is big and round.
The friends are scared but curious.
The alien is small and green.
The alien makes a soft sound.
Its eyes are big and sad.
"Please help me," the alien says in a weak voice.
The friends look at each other.
They feel sorry for the alien.
They take the alien out of the spaceship.
They give it water and food.
They do not want to give the alien away.
They want to keep it safe.
They know they made the right choice.
